create_Kosmos2_5Processor: create a Kosmos2_5Processor instance from an image processor and tokenizer with configurable num_image_tokens
run_process_images_text: run the processor to encode images and text into BatchFeature with input_ids, attention_mask, and image_embeds_position_mask
test_batch_decode: test batch_decode on encoded Kosmos2_5 outputs by forwarding to the underlying tokenizer's batch_decode
review_decode_method: review the decode method that forwards token IDs to the underlying tokenizer's decode for text generation
build_model_input_names: build the combined model_input_names list from both tokenizer and image_processor input names
